title: Security-critical authenticated vectors use production code as their claimed independent oracle
description: The SCHC draft claims canonical vectors are not derived from code under test, but authenticated/timing generators import production identity, Schnorr, IPv6, link, SCHC, RPL, and timing modules; root_signature.json names production root_signature.py and root_authorization.json calls lichen.crypto independent. Replace expected-value generation with independent primitives/reference construction or relabel provenance and add a truly independent verifier. Hidden signature-preimage drift demonstrates the present tautology.
